scope: Intersection POS×OSS — PII on public wall, branch isolation, channel-auth Sanctum

checks.title: Public customer-wall payload PII surface
checks.note: Token IS exposed — it is a public retrieval token already printed on kiosk receipts (the customer types it to check their own order). Not a session credential. Order_serial_no is the same number printed on the receipt. No private fields leak. Verified against Controller docstring lines 60..63 (publicIndex) explicitly attesting same.

checks.title: Branch isolation on OSS admin query
checks.rule_global_admin: branch_id=0 + hasRole('Admin') → can override via ?branch_id=N or get null (unscoped)
checks.rule_branch_staff: branch_id>0 → forced to own branch_id; cross-branch request aborts 403 line 259
checks.rule_unknown_user: branch_id=0 without Admin role → aborts 403 line 255 (anti privilege escalation)

checks.title: Branch isolation on OSS public wall query
checks.rule: branch_id from ?branch_id=N (if N>0) else first active branch. listForBranch() applies where('branch_id', N) — no cross-branch leakage.
checks.note: Anti-enumeration rate limit `oss-public` 60/min/IP (RouteServiceProvider:145..152) blocks branch_id sweep attacks.

checks.title: Channel-auth Sanctum on private-branch.{id} broadcast
rules: Kiosk token (name='kiosk-token') → must own a KioskMachine row matching branch — token-NAME-based check is immune to Sanctum '*' wildcard ability
Admin / Tenant Admin role → cross-branch allowed
Regular staff → own branch only (strict equality)
Customer / Guest (branch_id=0 default but no role) → falls into the last `return $user->branch_id === $branchId` clause → 0!=N → DENY
checks.note: [GOAL-CMS R3 T-3.2.2 Sec F-SEC-W6-01/02] explicitly closed the wildcard-token + Guest-Echo-Bypass paths recently — comment block lines 22..40 attests.

checks.title: OSS public endpoint exposes only PREPARING/PREPARED orders
checks.note: An attacker who probes ?branch_id=N cannot infer historical activity beyond current preparation queue — orders flush out after 8h via stale-prune (line 108).

checks.title: Source-surface fail-closed allowlist (RED R-3 heal)
checks.rule: Even if a POS=15 / DINING_TABLE=20 / DELIVERY=30 order happens to carry a token, it is EXCLUDED from the customer wall by the allowlist.
checks.note: Wave 3c sentinel: tests/Feature/OSS/OssCustomerScreenFilterTest.php covers POS+DINING+DELIVERY leak paths (test_pos_order_with_token_is_excluded, test_dining_table_..., test_delivery_...)

checks.title: Permission gate on admin index/popular-items
checks.note: Public endpoints (publicIndex/publicMostPopularItems) intentionally NOT in the permission gate — they ride the `frontend` middleware group (installed+apiKey+localization) only, scoped by IP rate-limit `oss-public`.

checks.title: Idempotency key isolation — same order multiple status transitions
checks.rule: sha1(eventType|orderId|oldStatus|newStatus|correlationId) — distinct correlation_id per request → legitimate re-transitions (PREPARING→PREPARED→PREPARING admin revert) each get a fresh outbox row.

verdict: ZERO P0/P1 security defects in POS×OSS intersection. Public wall PII surface is minimal-by-design and explicitly documented. Branch isolation triple-guarded (HTTP query scope + DB filter + private-channel auth).
